stories.title: Flint councillor warns of HMO “unwelcome precedent” as officers recommend approval
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council officers have recommended approval for a plan to turn a three-bedroom house in Flint into a four-person house in multiple occupation, known as an HMO. stories.title: iking boots to stand-up: Outdoor boss from Flintshire swaps the great outdoors for the comedy stage
stories.summary: A outdoor centre boss from Flintshire is swapping hiking boots for a microphone after taking up stand-up comedy just two years ago. stories.title: Police appeal to find missing Bagillt teenager Leon
